description: Everyday utterances that are NOT in the playbook index. Used by the eval harness to measure the fragment-level false-credit rate: none of these should be credited with a scam tactic.
fragments: Hi, can we move the meeting to three o'clock tomorrow?
The doctor said to take the tablet twice a day after food.
Your Ola is arriving in two minutes, the car is a white Swift.
Mom, I'll be home by eight, please keep dinner.
Sir, your table for four is ready, please follow me.
The train is running twenty minutes late today.
Can you send me the photos from the wedding on WhatsApp?
I've paid the electricity bill through the app, here's the receipt.
Happy birthday! Did you get the cake I sent?
The plumber will come tomorrow between ten and twelve.
Your Amazon package was delivered to the security desk.
Let's split the dinner bill, your share is six hundred.
The school has declared a holiday on Monday for the festival.
I'm calling to confirm your dental appointment on Tuesday at eleven.
The new phone plan gives you unlimited calls and two GB a day.
Grandpa, I got selected for the college cricket team!
We're out of milk, can you pick some up on the way home?
The gas cylinder will be delivered tomorrow morning.
Your flight to Delhi departs from terminal two at six forty.
I've transferred the rent to the landlord, same as every month.
Can you help me set up the new TV remote this weekend?
The library book is due back on Friday.
Our society meeting is at seven in the clubhouse.
The doctor's report is normal, nothing to worry about.
I'm at the bank branch, the queue is long but moving.
The insurance premium got auto-debited today as usual.
Beta, your father's blood pressure medicine is finished, please order it.
Your Zomato order is being prepared and will arrive in twenty five minutes.
Please bring your ID card for the passport appointment.
The cab driver says he's waiting near the temple gate.
I'll send the invoice from my office email tomorrow.
We watched the new movie, it was quite good.
The water supply will be off from ten to two for maintenance.
Your SIP of five thousand was debited as scheduled.
Can we reschedule the parent teacher meeting to next week?
The mechanic said the car service will cost four thousand.
I've booked the tickets, the show starts at nine.
Please share the recipe for the sambar you made on Sunday.
The RTO said the licence will be posted within ten days.
The vegetable vendor is coming at five, do you need anything?
Your fixed deposit matures next month, would you like to renew it at the branch?
I'll be travelling next week, can you water the plants?
The pharmacy has your prescription ready for pickup.
Your credit card statement is available in the app.
The dentist said the filling will take about thirty minutes.
Aunty, the kids are asking when you're visiting.
The hostel fee receipt is on the college portal.
Our team won the match by two wickets!
Your delivery partner may call you for directions.
Can you pick up the kids from school today, I'm stuck in traffic?
The tailor said the blouse will be ready by Thursday.
I've emailed you the itinerary for the Goa trip.
The electrician fixed the fan, it's working now.
Your subscription renews next month, you can cancel any time in settings.
The maid is on leave tomorrow, I'll manage breakfast.
Papa, I reached the hostel safely, will call on Sunday.
The bank branch is closed on the second Saturday.
Let's meet at the coffee shop near the metro station at four.
The vet said the dog needs a vaccine next month.
I paid the maintenance through the society app, no charge.
Hello, this is the clinic, the doctor is running thirty minutes late today.
Your Swiggy refund of two hundred forty rupees has been processed to your original payment method.
Ma'am, your saree order is out for delivery, the payment is already done online.
The gym membership renews on the fifteenth, you can pay at the front desk.
Hi, it's Karan, are we still on for badminton on Saturday morning?
Uncle, could you send me the address of the wedding venue?
The tuition teacher will come at five instead of four today.
Your Netflix payment went through, enjoy the new season.
The apartment association is collecting for the Ganesh festival, voluntary of course.
The bank sent a message that the new debit card has been dispatched.
I've reached the airport, boarding starts in half an hour.
The hospital pharmacy is on the ground floor next to billing.
The neighbour's cat got into our balcony again.
Our anniversary dinner is booked for eight at the Italian place.
The cable guy will come tomorrow to fix the set top box.
I need to renew my driving licence before it expires in March.
The train ticket is confirmed, seat thirty two, lower berth.
The kids' school fee is due on the tenth, I've paid it online.
Your parcel from Myntra is at the gate with the security guard.
Don't forget to take the umbrella, it might rain in the evening.
